title: Exact and estimated controlled-substance inventory counts
rule_summary: Schedule II inventory requires an exact count or measure; Schedule III through V opened containers may generally be estimated unless the container holds more than 1,000 units.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply counting method requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Exact and estimated controlled-substance inventory counts

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing counting method with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
